## Purpose

Describe the problem and resulting behavior.

## Related work

Use `Fixes #N` only when this PR fully resolves the issue; otherwise `Refs #N`.
Label the PR with the `type:*`, `area:*` and `initiative:*` labels of the issue it
closes (classify the diff if there is none). Vocabulary: the shared
[classify-issues skill](https://github.com/oyzuai/agent-workflows/blob/main/skills/classify-issues/SKILL.md).

## Validation

Checks performed and their actual results, including any not run.
